title: Lazy loading follow-ups: moves, index staleness and a stale comment
findings_note: s361 relay 2026-10-18: `vcs.move` in move_slice/commit_stage raises a raw OS error when the source file is gone; the `expects_body` closure keeps the load-time Index after apply_outline publish or a TUI reload; tests/test_store_lazy.py:150 comment is stale; Index.get is a linear scan per miss
boundary: **Not in this slice:** changing the lazy-loading decisions (s312, s361).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: s361 mapped a missing file on read to `corrupt`. A slice move still raises a raw `FileNotFoundError` when the file vanished between load and rename. The miss fallback guard reads the Index captured at load time, so after a publish it can skip a full load it should do (benign but surprising). A test comment still says every miss does a full load.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/store.py` (`move_slice`, `commit_stage`, the `expects_body` guard: read `State.index` instead of the captured one).
- `tests/test_store_lazy.py` (fix the comment at ~150); `CHANGELOG.md` under Fixed.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests; watch them go red.
2. Map the missing source on move to `corrupt`; make the guard read the live index.
3. Fix the comment; CHANGELOG; mutation-check.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - `python3.12 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch; the owner lands it.
